## Change

Describe the user-visible change and why it is needed.

## Verification

List the commands run and their results. For storage, indexing or search changes, include before/after measurements and compatibility or recovery checks.

## Contribution

- [ ] Every commit has my matching `Signed-off-by` line (`git commit -s`).
- [ ] Tests and examples use synthetic data; no credentials or private agent history are included.
